entry.title: New: Resolution 224 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT FOR PARK MAINTENANCE AND/OR IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS IN COUNCIL DISTRICT 6

Transfers $15,835 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 6)
